visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a white knit dress sits at a wooden counter in a government office. She smiles broadly and speaks to someone off-camera. The office background is filled with glass partitions, signs, and typical administrative equipment. (2) The scene cuts to a bathroom where the same woman, now in a black silk slip, is drying her damp hair with a white hairdryer. The lighting is bright and even. She looks into the mirror as she works on her hair. (3) In a modern kitchen, she is seen drinking from a white mug with a blue letter "B". On the shelf behind her are several other decorative mugs. She wears a black slip and her hair is still slightly wet. (4) She moves to a walk-in closet and selects a white, off-the-shoulder knit dress with black buttons from a rack of clothes. The closet is well-lit and contains various bags and garments. She holds the dress up to herself. (5) Her mother, an older woman with short hair wearing pink striped pajamas, is in the kitchen preparing breakfast. She smiles warmly at the camera while stirring a beverage. Outside the balcony window, the sky is overcast. (6) Back in the bedroom, the bride-to-be has white patches under her eyes and a hair roller in her bangs. Another person is seen using a curling iron on her hair. She looks calm and expectant as she prepares for the big day. (7) She puts on a pair of large pearl earrings and adjusts her white dress. She then sprays perfume on her neck and shoulders before doing a small dance in the closet. Her makeup is polished and elegant. (8) A car ride through a rainy city is shown. The camera captures the raindrops on the window and the car's infotainment screen playing a wedding song. The couple's hands are seen clasped together on the center console. (9) At the household registration office, the mother in a pink lace dress speaks excitedly to the camera. The office is bustling with people and has rows of red chairs and service counters. The bride enters holding a blue folder. (10) The groom, a bald man in a white dress shirt, walks into the office carrying a bouquet of white flowers. He greets the bride and their friends. They sit together at counter number 29 to begin the registration process. (11) Surrounded by four friends acting as witnesses, the couple laughs as they realize the bride forgot her ID. The groom and friends joke about the situation. They eventually sign the registration forms and show their new ID cards to the camera. (12) The video concludes with the couple and their party walking on a city street under umbrellas. They enter a Din Tai Fung restaurant and sit at a round table, sharing a meal of xiaolongbao and toasting their marriage with tea.
